name: job-map-diagrams
title_zh: 客户那件事拆成八段，现状与改造后各画一张
tagline_zh: 产品经理说「用户要什么」时，手里常只有一句模糊抱怨。它把抱怨拆成八段任务、标出每段的现状与改造后。
tagline_en: Turn a vague customer complaint into an eight-stage job map with evidence, showing the status quo and the after.
desc_en: Convert a customer problem and optional proposed intervention into an evidence-backed Jobs-to-be-Done job map showing the status quo, after state, or both as an Eraser Diagrams artifact. Use when a product manager wants to discover, draft, visualize, or compare the eight stages of a customer's job; do not use for project roadmaps or implementation plans.
why_zh: 它只画客户要完成的事，不画你要做的功能；八段结构固定，证据挂在段上，所以讨论时争的是事实不是措辞。
why_en: It maps the customer's job, not your features. Eight fixed stages, evidence attached per stage, so debates are about facts, not.
limit_zh: 只做 JTBD 八段任务地图，不做项目路线图或实施计划；没有 Eraser Diagrams 账号就出不了图。
limit_en: Only JTBD eight-stage job maps, not roadmaps or implementation plans. Without an Eraser Diagrams account you get text structure, not the diagram.
title_en: One customer job split into 8 stages, drawn before and after
